title: Long-Code Finite Transform
statement: Let $q$ be a natural number, let an encoded regular Unique Games family with alphabet size $q$ be given, and let a finite long-code test boundary for a sign tester with alphabet size $q$ be given. A long-code finite transform specifies natural numbers $r$ and $M$ with $0<M$ and $r\le M$, such that every tester check has arity at most $r$. For every semantic instance it also specifies a finite, nonempty set of refined occurrences, a map from those occurrences to outcomes of the associated allowed long-code weighted experiment, and the requirement that the uniform law on refined occurrences maps to that experiment's law.
